pro_course_detail.title: University Students' English
pro_course_detail.description:
These classes are for students in COLLEGE or UNIVERSITY higher education only (not high-school students). We can work on any area of English you choose to, whether it be conversation (speaking & listening), reading or writing. 
Most STUDENTS are looking for help in preparation for Academic IELTS to study abroad. Speaking practise is the most popular. We follow the exam format and cover as broad a range of topics as possible which can be divided into people, places, routines and activities, as well as objects. Part 1 focuses on relaxation and rhythm, part 2 on descriptive storytelling, and part 3 on stating opinions supported by reasoning and examples.
For the IELTS writing, we analyse your essays together in class for task achievement, structural coherence, grammar and use of vocabulary.
From time-to-time, students also ask me to help them with the IELTS reading where I place focus on developing the ability to switch between skim reading, scanning and intensive reading. 

Other exam preparation is also available such as CAMBRIDGE, TOEFL etc.

Please send me a message before booking to confirm the Lower OR Upper Intermediate Course, or the Advanced C1 OR C2 courses.

LOWER-INTERMEDIATE (B1)
Suited To:

This is suited to students who are making a transition from A2.  You know the basics, but cannot always use them accurately or can only carry out quite basic conversations.  Stronger students at this level can also speak about less familiar topics, but will often speak with long pauses.

DESCRIPTION:
. Warmer, comprehensive tasks, discussion questions/concept checking
. Phonetics
. Build fluency and pronunciation using repetition
. New vocabulary and A2 revision
. Simple grammatical forms
. Present, past, future, present continuous
. Listening practice to identify plurals, prepositions, verb tenses and more
. Speaking practice
. Building of writing/spelling level by using dictation, spelling quizzes and mini essays on familiar topics
. Homework

OR

UPPER-INTERMEDATE (B2)
Who are you:

You have progressed a lot since A1/A2 and can talk about a lot of everyday topics very easily.  And can handle many difficult topics also.  The difference between you and a B1 student is that you understand a lot more than you are able to say and this will be very frustrating.  If there is a word that you want to say, but you don't know how to, you know how to find a way around it. 

DESCRIPTION:
. Speaking is key
. Warm up activities followed by comprehensive tasks
. We will work on magazine/newspaper articles intensively, to build reading skills
. You will use audio to determine the speaker's mood, intonation, formal, informal
. More phonetics
. Dictation, exercises, quizzes
. Grammar
. Making request and complaining
. Prefixes/suffixes
. Comparatives /Superlatives
. Intensive focus on pronunciation
. Homework
+MORE
